newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch PTT sees further growth net income.
newsitem.headline: Dutch PTT sees further growth net income.

text.p: Dutch post and telecoms group Koninklijke PTT Nederland NV (KPN) said on Tuesday it expected further growth of net income in 1997.
The company earlier posted 1996 net profit of 2.46 billion guilders ($1.3 billion), up from 1995's 2.26 billion.
"For 1997, KPN expects a substantial growth of turnover and a clear growth of the profit after taxes," the company said in a statement.
It added that it expected to double turnover from postal activities, partly as a result of the previous takeovers of TNT and GDW.
"KPN also bases its expectations on a strong growth of the market for mobile telecommunications and a continuing growth of demand for newly introduced and existing services," it said.
